title: Evolving Ensemble of Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.09018v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce the Evolving Ensemble of Agents (EvE), a decentralized framework that organizes existing, highly capable coding agents into a live, co-evolving system for algorithmic discovery. Rather than reinventing the wheel within the ``LLMs as optimizers'' paradigm, EvE fixes the base agent substrate and focuses entirely on evolving the cumulative guidance and skills that dictate agent behaviors. By maintaining two co-evolving populations, namely functional code solvers and agent guidance states, the system evaluates agents through a synchronous race, updating their empirical Elo ratings based on the marginal gains they contribute to the current solver state. When applied to a research bottleneck in In-Context Operator Networks (ICON), EvE autonomously discovered a robust rescale-then-interpolate mechanism that enables reliable example-count generalization. translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.09018v4 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：我们引入了演化式智能体集合（EvE），这是一个去中心化框架，将现有的、高能力的编码智能体组织成一个实时、共同演化的系统，用于算法发现。与其在“LLMs作为优化器”范式内重新发明轮子，EvE固定基础智能体基质，并完全专注于演化累积的指导和技能，这些指导和技能决定智能体行为。通过维持两个共同演化的群体，即功能性代码求解器和智能体指导状态，系统通过同步竞赛评估智能体，根据它们对当前求解器状态贡献的边际增益更新其经验Elo评分。在应用于上下文算子网络（ICON）中的研究瓶颈时，EvE自主发现了一种稳健的“缩放后插值”机制，能够实现可靠的示例数泛化。至关重要的是，受控消融实验揭示了阶段性演化的绝对必要性。
tldr: EvE框架通过共同演化代码求解器和指导状态，自主发现了一种稳健的缩放后插值机制，显著提升了ICON的示例数泛化能力，并强调了阶段性演化的关键作用。
en_tdlr: The EvE framework co-evolves code solvers and guidance states to autonomously discover a robust rescale-then-interpolate mechanism, enhancing ICON's example-count generalization, with staged evolution proven essential.
